thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER — multiple 502/504s observed from hosted-api in us-west-3. Symptoms: ELB target failures + Route53 uneven failover. Impacting ~30% of requests to region-backed endpoints. Root TS: 1710601234

sarah (oncall): I'm on it. I see a big spike in 5xx on the ALB in usw3 (target-group tg-web-usw3). Starting graph grabs now.

mike (infra): Confirmed. ELB healthchecks failing for a subset of targets. CPU ok, but connections to backend ENIs timing out.

ashwin (eng-sre): Pulling runbook: regional-egress-deg. Plan suggestion: 1) Reduce Route53 weight for us-west-3 to 0.2, bump weights for us-west-2/us-east-1. 2) Start draining unhealthy TG targets in us-west-3. 3) Open AWS support case and request ELB control-plane check. 4) Update status page.

jessie (support): Customer impact: hosted-api customers in us-west-3 seeing p50 -> 1.2s and 25% errors on POST generation flows. Preparing status page message now. Which tenants are VIP? I'll DM sales.

incident-bot: Status page draft generated: "Partial service degradation in us-west-3 affecting some hosted-api customers. Engineers investigating." Link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/replace-later

marco (netops): AWS case opened: case# 1234567890. AWS notes occasional ELB backend detach events in usw3 reported by other customers. They asked for ELB logs and target health dumps.

ashwin (eng-sre): Running Route53 change via CLI now — switching weight quickly. Command:

```
aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z012345EXAMPLE --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"api.redwood.ai","Type":"A","SetIdentifier":"us-west-3","Weight":20,"AliasTarget":{"HostedZoneId":"Z2FDTNDATAQYW2","DNSName":"alb-usw3-123.elb.amazonaws.com","EvaluateTargetHealth":false}}}]}'
```

ashwin (eng-sre): Note: we're using weight units (total 100 across regions). I'll shift 40 -> us-west-2, 40 -> us-east-1, leave 20 to usw3 for slow-drain.

sarah (oncall): Applied the weight change. Monitoring key metrics.

mike (infra): Starting TG drain on tg-web-usw3. Command run: `aws elbv2 deregister-targets --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-3:... --targets Id=i-0abcd...`

mike (infra): Tailing alb logs — seeing backend connection timeouts and occasional ENI response code 523. Small snippet:

```
[2026-03-15T12:03:21Z] elb client: 10.0.1.23 backend: 10.1.5.67 "POST /v1/gen HTTP/1.1" 502 0 0 0 "-" "aws-elb/2.0"
```

jessie (support): Error rate dropping to ~6% in last 5m after weight shift. Customers reporting fewer failures. Updating status.

marco (netops): AWS replied: "We're investigating ELB control plane in us-west-3; no immediate mitigation on their side yet. Keep us posted on traffic shift effects."

ashwin (eng-sre): Adding an emergency autoscaling step for dedicated pools in other regions for capacity headroom: scaling +20% in us-west-2 and us-east-1. Run: `kubectl scale --replicas=...` on serving-deploy.

sarah (oncall): Verified health in fallback regions. Latency back to normal for most customers. Keeping a 15-20% weight on usw3 for graceful drain.

alice (product): For enterprise customers with SLA, can we enable automatic dedicated-region fallback? Sales needs a note.

ashwin (eng-sre): We can add fallback to Dedicated for flagged tenants; created ticket INF-3487 to track. Also setting followups: reduce Route53 TTL to 60s (to speed future failovers), request AWS RCA, and runpostmortem.

jessie (support): Status page updated: "Mitigation in progress. Traffic being shifted away from us-west-3; service performance improving." (ID on status: S-20260315-01)

mike (infra): ELB target counts in usw3 down as expected; no more new connections routed there from route53 change. Backend errors trending down.

incident-bot: Paging summary saved to incident log. Runbook checkpoint: weight-change, tg-drain, aws-case-opened.

ashwin (eng-sre): Quick note for the post-incident: collect ELB control plane logs, ENI detach timeline, Route53 change history, and any customer repros. I'll own the postmortem write-up.

sarah (oncall): Handing over to night oncall @ashwin in 15m. I'll remain reachable for context. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

alice (product): Thx — please tag me when postmortem is published so I can prepare customer comms.

jessie (support): I'll compile impacted tenant list and include error windows for billing credits review.

marco (netops): Leaving AWS case and ELB dumps in /shared/incidents/1710601234/. If anyone needs packet captures from the ENI layer ping me.

ashwin (eng-sre): Last check: error rate ~1.5%, p95 latency stable. Closing active mitigation but keeping monitoring escalations for 6h. Will create follow-up tickets.

sarah (oncall): Closing this thread for active paging; continuing post-incident actions in INF-3487.

incident-bot: Incident note: "Mitigation applied: route53 weighted shift + target drain; AWS support case opened; customer impact reduced." End of thread.
